blocks.text: Rasulullaah ﷺ fought and the revelation that pertained to them. Whenever I went to any one of them, they became overjoyed because I am related to Rasulullaah ﷺ. Hadhrat Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) was one of the Sahabah (RA) with the soundest knowledge. When I asked him one day about the Surahs that were revealed in Madinah, he informed me that twenty-seven Surahs were revealed in Madinah and all the rest in Makkah." [^1]

Hadhrat Ikrama says, "I heard Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA) say, 'From all of us, it is Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) who has the most knowledge of the previous scriptures and also understands best those matters that the Qur'aan and Ahadeeth are not explicit about.' When I informed Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) about what Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA) had said, he remarked, 'He himself has tremendous knowledge because he used to ask Rasulullaah ﷺ about matters that were Halaal and Haraam.'" [^2]

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) was once looking at a group of people gathered around Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) during the days of Hajj, asking him about the rites of Hajj. She remarked, "Of those (Sahabah (RA)) still alive, he knows the rites of Hajj best." [^3]
WHAT PEOPLE SAID AT THE DEMISE OF HADHRAT ABDULLAAH BIN ABBAAS (RA)

When the news of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA)'s death reached Hadhrat Jaabir (RA), he hit his one hand on the other and said, "The most knowledgeable and most tolerant of all people has passed away. By his demise, this Ummah has been afflicted with a calamity that can never be redressed." [^4]

Upon the demise of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA), Hadhrat Raafi bin Khudayj (RA) remarked, "All the people between the East and the West were dependent on the one who has passed away today for their knowledge." [^5]
Hadhrat Abu Kulthoom narrates that when Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) was buried, Hadhrat Ibn Hanafiyyah said, "Today the sage of this Ummah has passed away." [^6]
The Knowledge of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA), Hadhrat Ubaadah (RA), Hadhrat Shaddaad bin Aws (RA) and Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri (RA)
Hadhrat Amr bin Dinaar says, "Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) was regarded as one of the young Fuqahaa." [^7]
